fields.name: image
fields.label: Desktop media
fields.description: Desktop background image shown at 769px and above. For a background video, put a link to an .mp4 in the Content field instead of using an image.

fields.name: mobileImage
fields.label: Mobile media
fields.description: Optional mobile background image/video shown below 769px. Falls back to the desktop media when empty.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Content
fields.description: Title (as a heading), a tagline paragraph, and a link for the CTA button. Add disclaimer / fine-print text here too (start it with 'Disclaimer' or '#T&C') — it renders small and right-aligned automatically.

fields.name: ctaStyle
fields.label: CTA button background
fields.description: Button colour: White = white fill with black text; Navy = dark fill with white text.
